requirements.statement: Governance SHALL support explicit Design-stage acceptance of a Design Proposal.
Design-stage acceptance SHALL require passing Design Proposal Conformance and Design Assurance.
Design-stage acceptance SHALL produce a distinct planning-ready accepted state without making the Design Proposal repository normative authority.

assurance.rationale: The CLI exposure is mechanically decidable once Design acceptance semantics are fixed.

requirements.statement: The maintained runtime SHALL expose Design-stage acceptance through the governed acceptance interface.
